def transform2(grid):
    # Find a full straight separator of one color, then compare the two panels.
    row_sep=next((i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0] in (4,7)),None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        top,bottom=grid[:row_sep],grid[row_sep+1:]
        h=min(len(top),len(bottom)); w=min(len(top[0]),len(bottom[0]))
        a,b=top,bottom
        sep_color=grid[row_sep][0]
    else:
        col_sep=next(c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[c] for row in grid})==1 and grid[0][c] in (4,7))
        a=[row[:col_sep] for row in grid]; b=[row[col_sep+1:] for row in grid]
        h=len(grid); w=min(len(a[0]),len(b[0])); sep_color=grid[0][col_sep]
    palettes=set(v for row in a for v in row)&set(v for row in b for v in row)
    common=next(iter(palettes))
    return [[3 if a[r][c]==common and b[r][c]==common else common for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
